title: Product terms versioning and approved change lifecycle
workflow: Propose terms change with business justification
Classify whether new contracts or existing agreements are affected
Analyze fee, interest, reporting and ledger consequences
Collect approvals and customer notice/consent where legally required
Validate effective dates without overlapping conflicting editions
Activate approved version and preserve historical audit
invariants: No retroactive overwrite of customer contract terms
Contract migration requires contractual and legal authority
Effective dates distinguish legal approval from deployment time
Rates and fees must be represented by exact arithmetic policies
Do not compute customer interest using unapproved accounting mappings
Every term revision has traceable approver and source documents
Old versions remain available for statements and disputes
planned_tests: Historic accrual reference retains original version
Changing terms cannot edit posted journal
Out-of-window version unavailable to new account
approval_gate: Product committee and legal/CFO approval, customer notice rules and migration tests.
